description: This file defines the JsInvokeMessageProcessor class, which handles message processing for JavaScript invocation, compilation, execution, and resource management within a server environment, including response handling and script caching.

classes.name: JsInvokeMessageProcessor
classes.description: Handles message processing for JavaScript execution, including script compilation, invocation, release, caching, and response sending.

methods.name: onJsInvokeMessage
methods.description: Main entry point for processing incoming messages, parsing requests, and delegating to specific handlers.

methods.name: processCompileRequest
methods.description: Handles script compilation requests, compiling or returning cached scripts.

methods.name: processInvokeRequest
methods.description: Handles script invocation requests, executing scripts and managing results and errors.

methods.name: processReleaseRequest
methods.description: Handles script release requests, removing scripts from cache.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends response messages back to the message queue.

methods.name: getOrCompileScript
methods.description: Retrieves a cached script or compiles a new one if not cached.

methods.name: cacheScript
methods.description: Caches a compiled script and manages cache size.

methods.name: createRemoteResponse
methods.description: Creates a remote response object with request ID and optional responses.

methods.name: getScriptId
methods.description: Extracts script hash ID from a message.

methods.name: incrementUseScriptId
methods.description: Increments usage counter for a script ID.

methods.name: deleteMinUsedScript
methods.description: Removes the least used script from cache to maintain cache size.
